releaseName: The server on your machine, installed
summary: Hosted service, local install sprint: the self-hosted stack installs without a clone. Each server tag now publishes the API, worker and page-fetcher images to GitHub's container registry for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, and the self-hosted Compose file runs them by version. A draft-loop-server script, in bash and PowerShell, installs a release with Docker only, starts, stops and upgrades it, and backs it up and restores it as one private archive of the database, the files and the generated secrets. A new Self-hosted stack CI job installs each pull request's images the same way, runs a scripted run to an exported DOCX, backs the stack up, erases and restores it, and checks that its records, files and owner token came back.
knownLimitations: Staging behaviour is unchanged: these are self-hosted changes. The published images start as private packages until the owner makes them public. Importing a desktop workspace into the server (career evidence, applications and history) is not in this release (#2056, #2057). The Self-hosted stack CI job is not yet a required check.
